note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list as published on Exophase and PSNProfiles, the two agreeing on all 55. Guides are the author's own words; every guide names its sources. Methods that are unconfirmed say so and invent nothing.

GM.name: Gamemapa — All 55 GTA 6 Trophies: Full List, Gamerscore and Platinum Roadmap

KG.name: Keengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap – All 55 Trophies

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum unlocks itself. Follow the roadmap: play the story first, then work the 100% checklist, then clean up the Strangers & Freaks strands. Expect around 200 hours in total — 60 to 80 for the story, about 100 for the checklist, and roughly 10 for cleanup.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game, so this trophy cannot be missed — just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing the main story missions to their end. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2 by playing the main story missions to their end. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 by playing the main story missions to their end. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 by playing the main story missions to their end. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. Unmissable — it pops when the story ends. (Sources differ on whether to call it Chapter 5, so this guide only says the final mission.)
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.target: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable story trophy.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.target: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, only after the story ends. Most of it fills in while you chase the other trophies, so do it last. PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy and notes the thresholds are lenient — roughly 60% of true completion. Budget around 100 hours after the story for the leftover Challenges, stunts and collectibles.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps all count. Flying under bridges is reported as the fastest kind. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250 and the extra progress still counts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. You will touch most of them naturally while chasing other trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 Shooting Ranges. Work through one range at a time and repeat a challenge until the gold score lands.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — 42 races in total. Learn one location's course, win it, then move on to the next.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.target: Win a drone race at all 14 locations

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. The 100% checklist wants 30, so keep racing past 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing contest. His questline starts in Chapter 1, so look for him early and follow it through.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.target: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge

trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade video games. Three of them are on the TV at home, so you can do this between missions without travelling.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Andy's quests. Lucia only, from Chapter 3. Start the chain as soon as it unlocks — stranger mission chains have windows tied to story progress, so do not leave them for after the ending.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Clear all 7 shipwrecks for Kenton. Available from Chapter 1 — dive them as you come across them rather than saving them all for the end.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish all 5 of Billy's quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub. From Chapter 2.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands around Leonida. The named stranger chains (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) count toward this, so it fills in as you finish their final missions.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 cars on Randy's Wish List. From Chapter 3 — keep an eye out for wish-list cars while driving around and deliver them as you find them.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.target: Deliver all 16 cars on the Wish List

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Destroy the labs and finish Tyrone's final quest. Jason only, from Chapter 3.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — the only trophy both PowerPyx and GTABase flag. Early in Chapter 1, after a mission, Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house one morning and walks out to the balcony: follow her, accept the prompt and let her show you how it works. The balcony raises the Progress-menu meditation counter by 1 but is NOT marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and PowerPyx has not confirmed whether the trophy needs it — and you cannot do it again after Chapter 1. Do it in Chapter 1 to be safe. Count dispute: GTABase says 18 spots, the 100% checklist says 15. Both figures are shown here because the sources disagree.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.target: Meditate at every spot (18 per GTABase, 15 per the 100% checklist)

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Jason only. WHICH animal counts is unconfirmed — this guide does not guess. Check the guide sources for updates before you set out.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.target: Hunt a unique animal for Bret

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — there are 18 sets in total. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so keep collecting past 3.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to scan 100 locations — landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Scan everything new as you travel and the total climbs on its own.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70, so you can skip the nastiest ones — pick the 50 that suit you and leave the rest.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach a 4-star wanted level with your partner, then escape the red heat zone. Bank vault robberies often bring the wanted level on their own, so it often pops by itself. A reliable escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you. It unlocks once you leave the red heat zone.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.target: Escape a 4-star wanted level with your partner

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while still wanted. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City sit close together and work well. The trophy is delayed — it pops about half a minute after you leave the third store. If it still has not popped, rob a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning 100 different vehicles with WAiNK is enough — you do not need to drive them. Scan traffic near busy roads and the count climbs fast.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Before the fight, top up Focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, carry Adrenaline and use an assault rifle. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians — pick gang members at their illegal operations.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a docked passenger jet at VCIA and fly about 1 km away. The easiest airliner is docked at terminals E3/E4. It unlocks once you are 1 km from the airport.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.target: Fly a stolen jet 1 km from VCIA

trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. The official description is only a hint, so the method comes from player guides rather than the description itself.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.target: Take out enemies from a stolen tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store undetected. You need the Snap Gun (from Chapter 3): open the back door with it, find the safe code and clear out the safe without anyone spotting you.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 of the 8 bank vaults and escape. Requires the optional Chapter 4 mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', after which you follow a security van into a bank while its vault is open. Expect 4 stars — have a fast bike ready for the escape.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Watch for armored trucks on the road, hit one, grab the cash and lose the wanted level.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — clear the fog from the whole map. Flying over the dark patches is reported as the quickest method.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.target: Clear the fog from the whole map

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs. 39 operations exist, so you have plenty of choice — one per gang is all it takes.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Method UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists the condition as unknown, so this guide does not invent steps. Check the cited sources for updates.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.target: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Method UNCONFIRMED. One unconfirmed guess in circulation is crashing a car out through a showroom window — presented here only as a guess, never as fact.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.target: Smash out of a vehicle showroom

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn and lose the police. Grab the valuables, get out and break line of sight until the wanted level clears.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Max out Strength for Jason and Lucia at the same time. Tip: go to the gym together — while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress doubles.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.target: Max Strength for Jason and Lucia

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. The count is single-sourced, so treat it as approximate. Warning: avoid the permanent 'Irredeemable' criminal profile — it makes police more aggressive for the rest of the save.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: The description hints at a second attempt. Method UNCONFIRMED — this guide does not invent one. Check the cited sources for updates.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: The description hints at something strange. Method UNCONFIRMED. One unconfirmed guess links it to a strange event somewhere in Leonida — presented here only as a guess, never as fact.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by. The exact trigger is UNCONFIRMED — this guide does not invent one. Check the cited sources for updates.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your fences (contacts). One fence pays the most, and the total grows during the 100% robberies, so it fills in alongside Maximum Withdrawal and the other heists.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops. Normal spending on weapons, clothes, food and vehicles adds up — it usually pops on its own before the end of the 100% cleanup.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 total. The 4 story garages do not count — only the 8 you buy yourself.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Register cars you already own or find — any 10 count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
